boundaries: These semantics describe how already-approved product policies would have to be expressed by a future executor.
Only the four founder-approved D1-D4 account relations are promoted to DETACH/IMPLEMENTED; no destructive account-erasure executor is authorized.
A row can be operationally specified without being legally/privacy approved for execution.
D1-D4 DETACH schema support is implemented by SET NULL; all other schema or executor work remains separately gated.
Founder approved the privacy-first A option for respondent provenance, community creator provenance, event creator provenance, and moderation reporter identity on 2026-09-21.
community_rules_acceptances remains reserved to PRIVACY_LEGAL; research_data_consents and subscriptions remain outside these four product decisions.

policyDetermined.currentSchemaConstraint: user_id is nullable with ON DELETE SET NULL; account deletion can detach retained session evidence from the deleted account.
policyDetermined.implementationConsequence: Schema/runtime support for detached inactive sessions and read-only expired-row discovery are implemented. A future authorized executor must still revoke all active sessions before root deletion and perform deletion of rows only after their original expiry.

policyDetermined.currentSchemaConstraint: author_id is nullable but remains a NO ACTION user FK, so de-identification must be an explicit executor action and account deletion cannot silently anonymize content.
policyDetermined.implementationConsequence: Schema support for explicit author detachment is implemented; a future executor must still delete by default and may null author_id only after thread-integrity necessity is established and de-identification checks pass.

policyDetermined.currentSchemaConstraint: dog_id is nullable with ON DELETE SET NULL, so dog deletion can detach the device binding without deleting retained device metadata.
policyDetermined.implementationConsequence: Schema support for immediate unbind is implemented; the future executor must still enforce the bounded post-unbind retention, identifier minimisation and final purge/pseudonymisation lifecycle.

policyDetermined.currentSchemaConstraint: product and research rows share one physical table.
policyDetermined.implementationConsequence: Future executor must branch by administration_mode before deleting assessment parents.

policyDetermined.currentSchemaConstraint: database CASCADE is mechanical and will fire if the assessment parent is deleted.
policyDetermined.implementationConsequence: Parent assessment authority must be resolved before deletion; no independent child decision is needed.

authorityDecisionsRemaining.why: Rules acceptance is minimal evidentiary data (version + accepted_at) tied directly to the user. Its post-erasure necessity cannot be decided from product behavior alone.
authorityDecisionsRemaining.privacyFirstRecommendation: Do not retain identified acceptance evidence after erasure unless privacy/legal review establishes a concrete claims/compliance need and bounded duration.
